title: Gemma4 Agent Behavior vs Accuracy
subtitle: 1350 episodes: better process ≠ higher WT accuracy
description:
Companion dataset for Moran Zavdi's evidence-first retrospective "When Better Agent Behavior Does Not Improve Accuracy" (Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition).

Contains evidence/*.jsonl (1,350 episodes), scripts/reproduce_all_tables.py, notebooks/, benchmark/, and article figures.

Competition: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/gemma-4-developer-agent
